info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Replace Streaming Subscriptions Downgrade-v4-spec
info.description: The Subscription Downgrade Management API facilitates the process of managing streaming subscriptions by allowing users to downgrade their subscriptions. This API supports batch operations, enabling multiple subscriptions to be processed in a single request. It is designed for service providers and platform administrators who need to efficiently handle subscription changes for their customers. Typical use cases include adjusting subscription levels based on user preferences or promotional offers. The API ensures that customers can easily modify their subscriptions while maintaining an optimal user experience.

put.description: This operation allows you to downgrade the current subscription to a lower tier. Ensure that the new selected plan is appropriate for your needs, as this change might affect the services available to you.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to downgrade an existing subscription. It includes the necessary information for the downgrade process, such as the subscription ID and the new plan details.

206.description: Partial content returned indicating that the downgrade process is in progress.
